Product Details: The Xtra Power PH2 65mm High Torque Screwdriver Bits with Magnetic Ring is a professional-grade 10-piece set designed for demanding fastening tasks. Each bit is crafted to deliver high torque performance, making it ideal for heavy-duty screwdriving applications in woodworking, construction, and general repairs. The PH2 Phillips head design ensures a secure and precise fit, reducing the risk of cam-out and damage to screw heads. The integrated magnetic ring holds screws firmly in place, allowing for one-handed operation and improved efficiency, especially in tight or hard-to-reach spaces. At 65mm in length, these bits offer excellent reach and versatility for a wide range of projects. The set of 10 ensures you always have a spare on hand, minimising downtime on the job. Compatible with most standard power drills and screwdrivers, these bits are a reliable addition to any toolkit. Whether you are a professional tradesperson or a DIY enthusiast, this set from Xtra Power delivers consistent performance and durability.
